sources.title: Effect of Pipelining and Multiplexing in Estimating HTTP/2.0 Web Object Sizes
sources.snippet: HTTP response size is a well-known side channel attack. With the deployment of HTTP/2.0, response size estimation attacks are generally dismissed with the argument that pipelining and response multiplexing prevent eavesdroppers from finding out response sizes. Yet the impact that pipelining and response multiplexing actually have in estimating HTTP response sizes has not been adequately investigated.
